description: Ministry of City Planning and Water Supply - Order to approve the acquisition of immovable properties in Kobbewela and Bisowela in Galigamuwa D/S Division, Kegalle District for the constructions under the Galigamuwa Water Supply Scheme in Vattappalai, Muhudubadapattuwa D/S Division, Mullaitivu District for the constructions under Mullaitivu Water Supply Project
categorisation: The gazette content primarily concerns the acquisition of immovable property (land) for specific water supply projects. It details the approval of land acquisition under the National Water Supply and Drainage Board Act, including specific schedules with land descriptions, boundaries, and claimant information. This fits the definition of a Land Gazette, which deals with land acquisitions, transfers, and property-related matters.
